svg.aria-label: Terminal output: nails check (NixOS VM, decoy side)

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
text.tspan: NAILS Readiness Check
Pre-flight checks:
[PASS] hidden-volume: Hidden volume mounted at /mnt/data
[PASS] backend-entries: No fstab or crypttab entry opens or mounts the volume at /mnt/data
[PASS] session-state: on the plain decoy root
[PASS] platform: NixOS 26.11
[PASS] systemd-version: systemd 261 supports soft-reboot
[PASS] soft-reboot-units: soft-reboot.target and systemd-soft-reboot.service are installed
[PASS] decoy-root: the decoy root (ext4 on /dev/vda) can be mounted again for the way back
[PASS] fstab-policy: decoy filesystems in the hidden root: /nix/.ro-store: overlaid; /nix/store:
overlaid; /tmp/shared: overlaid; /tmp/xchg: overlaid
[PASS] mount-namespace: Running in PID 1's mount namespace with shared root propagation
[PASS] host-tools: All 5 required host tools are present
[PASS] network-tools: The way back finds nft, and iw where a link is a Wi-Fi interface
[PASS] symlink-support: Filesystem at /mnt/data supports symbolic links
[PASS] upper-fs-capability: Hidden root at /mnt/data can host an overlayfs upper layer
[PASS] backend-detect: Hidden root backend: ext4 on LUKS mapping dm-0 on block device vdb; no
backend-specific hazards detected
[PASS] cryptsetup-argon2id: If you use VeraCrypt: the installed cryptsetup 2.8.8 cannot open a
volume whose header key is derived with Argon2id (the "Argon2" entry in VeraCrypt 1.26.29 and
newer), and nothing outside the encrypted header shows which algorithm it used. Make both the
outer and the hidden VeraCrypt volume with PBKDF2: keep VeraCrypt's default key-derivation
function, or pick any entry other than Argon2. See docs/backends.md.
[PASS] storage-readiness: Hidden storage ready: all directories accessible
[PASS] suspicious-nails-reference: The 2 .nix files under /etc/nixos name nothing of the hidden
environment
[PASS] swap: no swap can leak memory to persistent storage (RAM-only zram is permitted)
[PASS] memory-wipe: The decoy kernel zeroes freed memory (init_on_free), so pages the hidden
session frees do not linger in RAM.
[PASS] dma-protection: The IOMMU is remapping DMA (an active IOMMU is present and the command line
does not put it in passthrough), so a DMA-capable device cannot freely read system RAM. A
machine left powered on and unlocked is still not safe against seizure — the live working set
stays plaintext in RAM while the volume is mounted; power off before handing it over.
[PASS] sleep-policy: host will not suspend an active session (HandleLidSwitch=lock,
IdleAction=ignore)
[PASS] decoy-persistence: decoy keeps no durable trace of the hidden session
[PASS] pending-offline-update: no pending offline update is staged on the decoy
[PASS] kernel-modules: the decoy keeps no kernel modules in /usr/lib/modules
[PASS] residue-catalog: no warned residue channel is live (6 catalog probes); noted: timer-stamps
(/var/lib/systemd/timers): Session stamps land in the upper; expect catch-up runs at the next
decoy boot. (see docs/decoy-requirements.md#session-time-records)
[PASS] space: 1.8 GB available (3.7x minimum required)
[PASS] binary-location: Running binary lives under the hidden volume root (/mnt/data)
[PASS] inherited-autostart: No inherited decoy item needs review (4 desktop and distribution
components not counted)
[PASS] incremental-history-flush: The operator's shell does not flush command history
incrementally
[PASS] state: System is inactive - ready for activation
Effective configuration:
config file: /mnt/data/config/nails.toml
hidden volume root: /mnt/data
state file: /mnt/data/state.json
log directory: /mnt/data/logs
persona mode: shared-home
minimum free space: 500 MB
Decoy filesystems in the hidden root:
- /nix/.ro-store: overlaid
- /nix/store: overlaid
- /tmp/shared: overlaid
- /tmp/xchg: overlaid
Session:
[INFO] activation soft-reboots into the hidden root: every program closes and you are logged out
NixOS profile:
[INFO] overlay-only: no hidden NixOS system is built; the session runs the decoy's own system
Inherited decoy state:
[INFO] shared-home: the hidden session starts in the decoy home, so the decoy's accounts, keys,
browser profiles and shell history are live in it (persona.mode = "fresh-home" starts it in an
empty home)
[PASS] nothing to review
[INFO] 4 components of the desktop or distribution not listed (--json lists every entry)
[PASS] Ready to activate (30 passed, 0 warnings, 0 failed)

svg.text: Real output captured from the session-readme-captures NixOS VM test in run ID 40383365802 of the E2E workflow on
GitHub's hosted runners, 2026-10-26, on a test VM set up as docs/decoy-requirements.md recommends, with nails
run from the hidden volume through sudo. dma-protection passes because the test VM also has QEMU's emulated
Intel IOMMU, turned on with intel_iommu=on; it warns when the IOMMU is off or in passthrough, when a Thunderbolt
or USB4 controller reports no DMA protection, and with Linux 5.14 or newer when an IOMMU group is identity-
mapped (see docs/operator-guide.md). --overlay-only skips the hidden NixOS build; /nix/.ro-store, /tmp/shared
and /tmp/xchg are the test VM's own mounts.
